about: Which way the missile spread turns: the primary fires the MLS-4X Commando's missile (its package held), whose stats give a 45 degree veer at direction 0 from 0.05 to 0.5 s and a curve of 90 degrees a second about the curve's first axis (curve_pitch) only. The probe logs the first missiles' heading against their launch frame (local Y forward, Z up) and says which way direction 0 went (expected: up) and which way the first curve axis turned (expected: pitch, in the up plane). The harness holds the trigger until the log shows a missile at 0.8 s (tests/in-game/README.md).
